values: 一名具有辅助能力的坦克，可以为多名友军添加护盾。
A Support Tank who can grant shields to multiple allies.
来吧，以我全部的生命与荣耀发誓，我将守护你。
By my life and honor, I shall protect you.
坚盾护人，厚铠护己，开始吧。
Shield for others, armor for myself. Let's get started!
骑士卢修斯，为了圣光的荣耀。
I'm Sir Lucius. All glory to the divine light!
哦，真够结实，不管拿多久，这分量也真不轻啊。
Oh, hahaha. Wow, haha. So cute
Ugh, that's really heavy! No matter how long I hold it, it doesn't get easier.
要是把它带到骑士团，一定会被大家羡慕吧，哈哈哈！
Ha! The Heroic Order would surely envy this!
阁下放心！我一定珍藏这份礼物，不会轻易使用的。
Rest assured, I do not take this honored gift lightly.
Do you have some oil to spare? I want to polish my armor.
These lights are as brilliant as the stars.
On this winter night... it's pure magic.
These lights are reflecting off my shield so well!
May the Divine Light brighten the night!
卢修斯的翼冠是一位名匠赠与的，他虽然十分爱护，却完全不知道其真正的价值。在他眼里，这是和孩子们用野草编织的花冠同等价值的礼物。
Lucius' winged crown was a gift from a famed craftsman. He takes good care of it without knowing its true value. To him, it's as precious as those flower wreaths that kids give him.
大家都对卢修斯的关心敬谢不敏，因为无论什么样的问题，他都会试图用“去跑两圈吧，心情或许会好一点”解决。
No one seems to appreciate Lucius' advice since his answer to all problems is to "go for a run, and you'll feel better."
“就算遇到笑不出来的情况，副队长也会大笑，跟着他一起笑的话，心情好像真的会好一点。”——圣堂骑士团成员
"Even in the most awful situation, the deputy captain chooses to laugh. When we laugh with him, everything seems to become better." —A Templar Order member
圣堂的墓园里，卢修斯父母的席位旁，始终空着一个位置。
The tombstone of Lucius' parents in the Temple Cemetery has space for one more name.
卢修斯抓住了一个偷面包的小贼，对方声称自己不想让家人饿死，卢修斯便放走了他。后来这位小贼因盗窃贵族的藏酒被捕，卢修斯也受到嘲笑，但他并未后悔。

Lucius once caught a bread thief but let him go when he heard that he was stealing for his family. Later, when this same thief was arrested for stealing aged wine from a noble, Lucius was laughed at, but he never regretted it.
卢修斯经常在执行任务的路上跑去帮助别人，这导致他经常在会合途中失踪，最严重的一次他整整晚到了两周，书记官甚至已经写好他的阵亡报告。

Lucius is often distracted by people in need while on missions, causing him to miss his rendezvous. Once, he was late for two weeks. When he finally got there, the clerk already had his death report written.
卢修斯一丝不苟地执行着圣堂骑士誓言，这让他与绝大部分贵族子弟格格不入。
Lucius meticulously upholds the Templar Knights' oath, making him incompatible with most noble youths. "He's such a stickler for the rules" —Lord Reginald's aunt's nephew's classmate
卢修斯很喜欢喂鸽子，他甚至给骑士团广场上的鸽子们每只都起了不同的名字。

Lucius loves to feed pigeons. He actually has a name for every pigeon in the Heroic Plaza. "That one is Cher, and that's Ami. This is Winkie. He only likes crusts." He says as he instructs local kids about feeding the birds.
缘于家族支持，卢修斯从来没为钱发过愁，这也导致他至今为止都没什么金钱概念——或许这算是他的缺点之一吧。
Money has never been an issue for Lucius thanks to his family's support, which results in his lack of concern when it comes to finances. This is probably one of his rare shortcomings.
圣堂不止一次地想要提拔卢修斯，但被卢修斯以“特弥希娅比我更适合这份荣誉”为理由婉拒了。
The Temple offered promotion opportunities to Lucius on multiple occasions, but he turned them all down and recommended Temesia for them instead.
特弥希娅，你之前买的苹果还放在我这里，快要坏掉了，你还要吗？
Temesia, the apples you bought but forgot at my place are about to rot. Still want them?
Do you have some oil to spare? I want to polish my armor.
These lights are as brilliant as the stars.
On this winter night... it's pure magic.
These lights are reflecting off my shield so well!
May the Divine Light brighten the night!
唔唔，我脸上的毛毛是不是有点脏了呀……
Hmm, is there a bit of dirt on my face?
漫漫 & 满满 & 卢修斯 & 维伦
圣堂的骑士也是不容易啊。
Being a knight of the Temple is not easy.
一、二、三！怎么样，这些够了吗？
One, two, three! How about this? Is that enough?
卢修斯 & 漫漫 & 满满
